title: Remote viewing a Guantanamo detainee: five white figures

tellings.quote: and then um lo and behold not too long later a major news media article came out I'm not going to say which one um that detailed this detainee's experience with uh what apparently the detainee perceived as as five white figures over his bed shaking his bed

plain: Luis Elizondo, the subject of a documentary episode on the show, says an effort at remote viewing, trying to perceive a distant person or place with the mind alone, was aimed at a detainee held at Guantanamo Bay, the US military prison in Cuba, and that not long after, a major news article he will not name described the detainee seeing five white figures over his bed, shaking it. Elizondo tells it first-hand from the Pentagon side, mentioning a man named Hal Puthoff, and offers it as a sign that the remote viewing had matched something real.
